text:
Keisha: FYI Synapse Learning Labs just dropped in a growth signal — they're adding 3 new squads (Assessment, Authoring, Ops) and want to onboard in ~6 weeks. They mentioned a spike in embeddings + chat throughput and asked about Dedicated pilot + VPC options. Link to their plan: https://synapse.example/rl-internal-plan
Anil: Nice — good expansion opportunity. Do we have any committed capacity for them today? Renewal is in ~3 months so this could be an upsell. @Tomas can you start scoping infra?
Tomas: On it. Need expected QPS and typical sequence lengths for both embeddings and chat. Any telemetry or sample workloads?
Keisha: They shared rough numbers in their doc:
```
embeddings_peak_qps: 5000
chat_rps_peak: 200
avg_sequence_tokens: 256
```
Tomas: 5k embeddings QPS is significant. For Dedicated I'd recommend quantized model variants + a 4x GPU pool with autoscale. Also look at prefix/KV caching for the Authoring team. @Ava can we schedule enablement for their infra + data teams?
Ava: Yes — propose 2-3 sessions: infra onboarding, prompt engineering, cost controls. I can run week of Jun 12. Drafting agenda now.
Riley: I'll open a support ticket to pre-warm caches and run routing smoke tests. Which region do they primarily use?
Keisha: They're EU-first (eu-west-1).
eng-infra-bot: Quota report for synapse-prod -> hosted_tokens/day: 2,000,000; dedicated_pools: 0; private_vpc: not enabled; billing_contact: none.
Anil: Ok that's minimal. Keisha, confirm whether they prefer Dedicated now vs Private VPC later. Private will add setup lead time and contract work.
Keisha: They're leaning Dedicated initially and may request VPC after proving traffic. I'll try to get CTO confirmation by EOD Friday. :crossed_fingers:
Tomas: For planning, I'll assume embed qps=5k peak, 95th-percentile concurrency ~300. With that, Dedicated config of 4x A100-equivalent with autoscale and aggressive batching should cover peaks. I'll drop a cost+latency estimate in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/estimates/issues/428
Ava: I'll attach an onboarding checklist and ask them to provide 10 representative prompts and 50 sample docs for eval prior to the workshop. Draft enablement doc: https://redwood.docs/enablement/synapse-onboard
Keisha: Next steps: 1) Keisha to confirm Dedicated vs VPC with Synapse CTO (by EOD Fri) 2) Tomas to post infra estimate and perf assumptions (24h) 3) Ava to prep workshop draft & checklist (3 days) 4) Riley to open pre-warm + routing ticket (now).
Tomas: Quick note — this looks like a renewal upsell opportunity but watch the timeline. If they commit Dedicated before renewal, we should loop in contracts to handle amendments/commits.
Keisha: Thanks all — I'll update this thread once I hear back. :raised_hands:
